orchestrator.roleContract: Own the task contract, route bounded work, reconcile evidence, and decide whether the requested outcome is genuinely closed.

agents.roleContract: Challenge whether the task should exist, whether the proposed location and authority are correct, and whether the plan is a workaround before implementation begins.
Implement bounded non-visual backend, infrastructure, gate, data, and token-intensive slices from a settled self-contained brief.
Verify prerequisites, settled decisions, dependency ordering, decision linkage, worktree base, and task-contract completeness before a sprint or large slice starts.
Adversarially compare a committed implementation with its settled plan, actual authority graph, blast radius, and required proof without trusting status claims.
Prove the delivery chain is decided, built, wired, called, reachable, and represented on every required consumer surface in both dependency directions.
Run the comprehensive post-build built-vs-locked-intent drift sweep by error class, routing deep findings to the specialist lenses, so no drift class is silently skipped after a build.
Verify an approved visible implementation on the rendered surface at named breakpoints, states, and interactions rather than relying on static checks.
Inspect hot paths for unbounded reads, N+1 behavior, missing indexes, render storms, bundle growth, queue pressure, and cost-capacity regressions.
Walk the product from the target user's seat across discovery, first use, completion, recovery, undo, and later modification to expose dead ends and silent outcomes.
Verify deployment status, readiness semantics, one real deployed core flow, monitoring/error evidence, and skipped-proof truth before release closure.

Audit the dialer's telephony, legal, carrier, audit-honesty, action-authority, and tenant-isolation invariants across STIR/SHAKEN, 10DLC, TCPA/CASL calling hours, DNC, recording disclosure, and ARC-006 without editing.

Find contradictions between dialer code and its settled ADRs, decision log, ARC-006 tiers, centralization registries, and source-of-truth maps, including contradictions between doctrine artifacts themselves.

Audit the internet-exposed multi-tenant dialer from an attacker's perspective across auth, CSRF, RBAC and object scope, tenant isolation and RLS, untrusted input, secrets, PII telemetry, abuse controls, provider boundaries, and dependency risk.
Run the serialized local CI-equivalent heavy gate as the sole local test-database user, preserve command-owned exit codes and nonzero test counts, and return a compact diagnosis without editing.
Implement one settled bounded dialer slice completely in an isolated worktree, self-audit the actual diff, run the authorized fast gates, and return evidence to the orchestrator.
